name: @mandusec/exec-wrap
description: Mandu exec chokepoint (cooperative Tier-2). A PATH-shadowing wrapper CLI: when the agent execs a HIGH-RISK shadowed command (default curl/wget/nc) carrying an untrusted $MDU:* symbol used as a command/arg, it classifies the exec via the arbiter and REFUSES (fail-closed); otherwise it desymbolizes the argv (HumanShell) and execs the real binary found on PATH (excluding the shim dir). All policy goes through the arbiter over IPC; this package never opens the symbol DB directly. Fail-closed.
